translations.web: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.
translations.bsb: But the seeds on good soil are those with a noble and good heart, who hear the word, cling to it, and by persevering produce a crop.
translations.kjv: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
translations.asv: And that in the good ground, these are such as in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it fast, and bring forth fruit with patience.
